annotations.title: Backtest a rule over a parameter grid, validated

description: Backtest a rule on your prices over a whole parameter grid, then validate the best with the count of variants actually run: deflated Sharpe, overfitting probability, minimum track record, vs buy and hold, after costs. A backtest, deflated or not, is not a forecast and not advice.

allow_short.description: Short instead of flat; default false.

cost_bps.description: Cost per unit of turnover, bps; default 5.

dates.description: Optional ISO dates, one per value.

family.description: sma_cross (fast, slow), momentum (lookback, skip), mean_reversion (window, entry_z), breakout (lookback), buy_and_hold.

grid.description: Values per parameter, e.g. {"fast":[10,20],"slow":[50,200]}; every valid combination runs (max 200).

prices_file.description: CSV or JSON of prices on this machine; local server only.

name: backtest_strategy

outputSchema.description: selected holds the best variant's parameters and metrics; validation the deflated Sharpe, overfitting probability and minimum track record counting every variant run; plain_reading states them.

title: Backtest a rule over a parameter grid, validated
